node.title: PMA constant-shift-pencil sub-two-ell saturation exclusion
node.statement: Over every field, a saturated full-petal chart whose locators are constant shifts P-a_i of one monic degree-ell polynomial, with at least three touched petals, has no exact defect in the strict strip ell<d<2ell. Two-block division by P forces the quotient-label matrix to rank at most two; three distinct labels then force one constant value, hence W=cF, contradicting gcd(F,W)=1. The bounds are sharp: t=2 and d=2ell both have explicit saturated F_7 counterexamples. Multiplicative cosets are the case P=X^ell; the arbitrary-locator PMA source bridge remains open.
